mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_message (session_id, `role`, content, image_url, reasoning_content, reasoning_ms, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{reasoningContent}, #{reasoningMs}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, `role`, content, image_url, reasoning_content, reasoning_ms, created_at FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT image_url FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url <> ''
SELECT DISTINCT image_url FROM t_ai_message WHERE image_url IN #{url}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.`role` = 'user'
SELECT DISTINCT m.image_url FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.image_url IS NOT NULL AND m.image_url <> ''
mapper.delete: DELETE m FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
